```{=html}
<div class="powder-animation" data-powder-animation>
  <svg viewBox="0 0 400 400" role="img" aria-label="Powder-bed fusion printing animation">
    <rect class="powder-frame" x="18" y="18" width="364" height="364" rx="8"></rect>
    <rect class="powder-chamber-back" x="46" y="150" width="118" height="198" rx="5"></rect>
    <rect class="powder-chamber-back" x="188" y="150" width="166" height="198" rx="5"></rect>
    <rect class="powder-feed-powder" x="52" y="150" width="106" height="174" rx="2"></rect>
    <rect class="powder-bed-bulk" x="194" y="150" width="154" height="0" rx="2"></rect>
    <rect class="powder-bed-powder" x="194" y="150" width="0" height="12" rx="2"></rect>
    <g class="powder-final"></g>
    <g class="powder-current"></g>
    <g class="powder-active"></g>
    <line class="powder-top-level" x1="46" y1="150" x2="354" y2="150"></line>
    <g class="powder-feed-piston">
      <rect class="powder-piston-rod" x="-4" y="8" width="8" height="44" rx="3"></rect>
      <rect class="powder-piston-plate" x="-53" y="0" width="106" height="10" rx="3"></rect>
    </g>
    <g class="powder-build-platform">
      <rect class="powder-platform-rod" x="-4" y="8" width="8" height="44" rx="3"></rect>
      <rect class="powder-platform-plate" x="-77" y="0" width="154" height="10" rx="3"></rect>
    </g>
    <g class="powder-recoater">
      <path class="powder-recoater-body" d="M -25 -30 H 25 L 0 0 Z"></path>
    </g>
    <g class="powder-laser">
      <circle class="powder-laser-mirror" cx="271" cy="72" r="8"></circle>
      <line class="powder-laser-beam" x1="271" y1="72" x2="271" y2="150"></line>
      <circle class="powder-laser-dot" cx="271" cy="150" r="4"></circle>
    </g>
    <path class="powder-chamber-front" d="M 46 150 H 164 V 348 H 46 Z"></path>
    <path class="powder-chamber-front" d="M 188 150 H 354 V 348 H 188 Z"></path>
  </svg>
</div>
<script>
(() => {
  const roots = document.querySelectorAll("[data-powder-animation]:not([data-powder-ready])");
  if (!roots.length) {
    return;
  }

  const svgNamespace = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const layerHeight = 12;
  const layerGap = 2;
  const layerCount = 15;
  const stepsPerPhase = 40;
  const stepsPerLayer = stepsPerPhase * 2;
  const stepMilliseconds = 1000 / stepsPerPhase;
  const visibleLayerHeight = layerHeight - layerGap;
  const topLevelY = 150;
  const feedLeftX = 52;
  const feedRightX = 158;
  const feedPistonBaseY = 324;
  const feedPistonLiftPerLayer = 6.1;
  const buildLeftX = 194;
  const buildRightX = 348;
  const sourceMinX = 76;
  const sourceMaxX = 324;
  const partMinX = 198;
  const partMaxX = 344;
  const recoaterStartX = 22;
  const recoaterEndX = 370;
  const recoaterY = topLevelY;
  const laserScanMinX = buildLeftX;
  const laserScanMaxX = buildRightX;
  const material = "#4f7f99";
  const activeMaterial = "#ee9d35";
  const finalMaterial = "rgba(79, 127, 153, 0.14)";
  const powderMaterial = "#c5c8ca";
  const partWidths = [
    [136, 264],
    [136, 264],
    [132, 268],
    [130, 270],
    [128, 272],
    [126, 274],
    [122, 278],
    [118, 282],
    [84, 316],
    [84, 316],
    [96, 304],
    [110, 290],
    [126, 274],
    [144, 256],
    [164, 236],
  ];

  function clamp(value, min = 0, max = 1) {
    return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
  }

  function easeInOut(t) {
    return t < 0.5 ? 2 * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 2) / 2;
  }

  function mapX(x) {
    const t = (x - sourceMinX) / (sourceMaxX - sourceMinX);
    return partMinX + t * (partMaxX - partMinX);
  }

  const layers = partWidths.map(([start, end]) => ({
    start: mapX(start),
    end: mapX(end),
  }));

  function makeRect(parent, segment, y, fill, endX = segment.end) {
    const width = Math.max(0, Math.min(segment.end, endX) - segment.start);
    if (width <= 0) {
      return;
    }
    const rect = document.createElementNS(svgNamespace, "rect");
    rect.setAttribute("x", String(segment.start));
    rect.setAttribute("y", String(y));
    rect.setAttribute("width", String(width));
    rect.setAttribute("height", String(visibleLayerHeight));
    rect.setAttribute("rx", "2");
    rect.setAttribute("fill", fill);
    parent.appendChild(rect);
  }

  function completedLayerY(layerIndex, currentLayer, downProgress) {
    return topLevelY + (currentLayer - 1 - layerIndex + downProgress) * layerHeight;
  }

  function finalLayerY(layerIndex) {
    return topLevelY + (layerCount - 1 - layerIndex) * layerHeight;
  }

  function setRectYHeight(rect, y, height) {
    rect.setAttribute("y", y.toFixed(2));
    rect.setAttribute("height", Math.max(0, height).toFixed(2));
  }

  function prepState(progress) {
    const feedRise = easeInOut(clamp((progress - 0.1) / 0.15));
    const downProgress = easeInOut(clamp((progress - 0.25) / 0.15));
    const forwardProgress = easeInOut(clamp((progress - 0.4) / 0.35));
    const returnProgress = easeInOut(clamp((progress - 0.75) / 0.25));
    const recoaterX = returnProgress > 0
      ? recoaterEndX + (recoaterStartX - recoaterEndX) * returnProgress
      : recoaterStartX + (recoaterEndX - recoaterStartX) * forwardProgress;
    const feedScrape = returnProgress > 0
      ? 1
      : clamp((recoaterX - feedLeftX) / (feedRightX - feedLeftX));
    const buildFill = returnProgress > 0
      ? 1
      : clamp((recoaterX - buildLeftX) / (buildRightX - buildLeftX));
    return {
      buildFill,
      downProgress,
      feedRise,
      feedScrape: forwardProgress > 0 ? feedScrape : 0,
      recoaterX,
    };
  }

  function renderStatic(root) {
    const finalGroup = root.querySelector(".powder-final");
    finalGroup.textContent = "";
    layers.forEach((layer, index) => {
      makeRect(finalGroup, layer, finalLayerY(index), finalMaterial);
    });
  }

  function renderFrame(root, step) {
    const currentLayer = Math.floor(step / stepsPerLayer) % layerCount;
    const layerStep = step % stepsPerLayer;
    const isLaserScanning = layerStep >= stepsPerPhase;
    const phaseStep = layerStep % stepsPerPhase;
    const phaseProgress = phaseStep / (stepsPerPhase - 1);
    const state = isLaserScanning
      ? {
          buildFill: 1,
          downProgress: 1,
          feedRise: 1,
          feedScrape: 1,
          recoaterX: recoaterStartX,
        }
      : prepState(phaseProgress);
    const currentGroup = root.querySelector(".powder-current");
    const activeGroup = root.querySelector(".powder-active");
    const bedPowder = root.querySelector(".powder-bed-powder");
    const bedBulk = root.querySelector(".powder-bed-bulk");
    const feedPowder = root.querySelector(".powder-feed-powder");
    const feedPiston = root.querySelector(".powder-feed-piston");
    const platform = root.querySelector(".powder-build-platform");
    const recoater = root.querySelector(".powder-recoater");
    const laserBeam = root.querySelector(".powder-laser-beam");
    const laserDot = root.querySelector(".powder-laser-dot");
    const laserMirror = root.querySelector(".powder-laser-mirror");

    currentGroup.textContent = "";
    activeGroup.textContent = "";

    layers.forEach((layer, index) => {
      if (index >= currentLayer) {
        return;
      }
      makeRect(currentGroup, layer, completedLayerY(index, currentLayer, state.downProgress), material);
    });

    if (isLaserScanning) {
      const laserX = laserScanMinX + (laserScanMaxX - laserScanMinX) * phaseProgress;
      const activeLayer = layers[currentLayer];
      if (laserX > activeLayer.start) {
        makeRect(activeGroup, activeLayer, topLevelY, activeMaterial, laserX);
      }
      laserBeam.setAttribute("x2", laserX.toFixed(2));
      laserBeam.setAttribute("y2", String(topLevelY));
      laserDot.setAttribute("cx", laserX.toFixed(2));
      laserDot.setAttribute("cy", String(topLevelY));
      laserBeam.setAttribute("opacity", "1");
      laserDot.setAttribute("opacity", "1");
      laserMirror.setAttribute("opacity", "1");
    } else {
      laserBeam.setAttribute("opacity", "0");
      laserDot.setAttribute("opacity", "0");
      laserMirror.setAttribute("opacity", "0.38");
    }

    const feedPistonY = feedPistonBaseY - (currentLayer + state.feedRise) * feedPistonLiftPerLayer;
    const feedSurfaceY = topLevelY - layerHeight * state.feedRise * (1 - state.feedScrape);
    const platformY = topLevelY + (currentLayer + state.downProgress) * layerHeight;
    const bulkTopY = topLevelY + state.downProgress * layerHeight;
    const bulkHeight = currentLayer * layerHeight;
    const buildPowderWidth = (buildRightX - buildLeftX) * state.buildFill;

    feedPowder.setAttribute("fill", powderMaterial);
    setRectYHeight(feedPowder, feedSurfaceY, feedPistonY - feedSurfaceY);
    bedBulk.setAttribute("x", String(buildLeftX));
    bedBulk.setAttribute("width", String(buildRightX - buildLeftX));
    setRectYHeight(bedBulk, bulkTopY, bulkHeight);
    bedPowder.setAttribute("x", String(buildLeftX));
    bedPowder.setAttribute("width", buildPowderWidth.toFixed(2));
    setRectYHeight(bedPowder, topLevelY, layerHeight);
    feedPiston.setAttribute("transform", `translate(105 ${feedPistonY.toFixed(2)})`);
    platform.setAttribute("transform", `translate(271 ${platformY.toFixed(2)})`);
    recoater.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${state.recoaterX.toFixed(2)} ${recoaterY})`);
  }

  roots.forEach((root) => {
    root.dataset.powderReady = "true";
    renderStatic(root);
    let step = 0;
    renderFrame(root, step);
    window.setInterval(() => {
      step = (step + 1) % (layerCount * stepsPerLayer);
      renderFrame(root, step);
    }, stepMilliseconds);
  });
})();
</script>
```
